c2f960.title: OYO-related web surface discovery: Checkin and legacy host redirects
c2f960.content:
Passive scope-compliant mapping (all requests through Strix proxy; no form submission or state mutation).

## Verified reachable public surface
- `https://www.checkin.life/` returned 200 (`text/html; charset=utf-8`), React/React-Helmet + Webpack application. Captured root exchange: `b8275957-aa1c-42fe-8dd3-bdcdd7711135`.
- Static bundle requests all returned 200 and are journaled: runtime `e81735a0-9e36-455b-8f37-7de2c5888816`, common `a020e0f2-13e1-4517-b2af-749482cedf78`, commoncss `65f18d01-e79f-4eb4-a14e-c111336423a7`, home widget `da946cb0-acf8-4f20-bd1c-c702400d764d`, main client `91504428-12a8-4dd1-aa11-7502ab6401a5`.
- Public Checkin routes in HTML/client bundle: `/`, `/search/`, `/termsandconditions/`, `/privacypolicycheckin/`; client also includes `/login`, `/reset-password`, `/accountdetails`, `/accountdetails/oyomoney`, `/booking/`, `/booking-paid/`, `/my-booking`, `/saved-hotels`, `/wishlist`, `/wizard`, `/wizard/renew/`, `/wizard/upgrade/`, `/referral/`, `/rewards`, `/faq/`, `/contactus`, `/travel-agencies`, `/searchaffiliate/`, `/sitemaps/countries-p0/`.
- Homepage hotel-search form is client-managed (no HTML method/action): destination text field `#autoComplete__home`; the published `/search/` links disclose query keys: `checkin`, `checkout`, `country_id`, `filters[city_id]`, `flexibleDaysCount`, `guests`, `isLatLngSearch`, `location`, `ratePlan[id]`, `ratePlan[type]`, `ratePlan[values]`, `rooms_config`, `searchType`, `showMap`.
- JS declares API base `https://api.oyorooms.com` (referenced only; not requested because it is outside the provided scheme scope) and these relative API paths: `/api/pwa/getHotelData`, `/api/pwa/getHotelDetailUrlSeo2Dot0`, `/api/pwa/checkHotelAvailability`, `/api/pwa/bookingPropertMeta` (GET observed in client code), `/api/pwa/hotelrating/{hotel-id}`, `/api/pwa/bookingCancellationReasons/`, `/api/pwa/authenticate`, `/api/pwa/authenticateV2`, `/api/pwa/authenticateV3`, `/api/pwa/loginOptions`, `/api/pwa/signup` (POST default in client code), `/api/pwa/forgotPassword`, `/api/pwa/resetPassword`, `/api/pwa/verification`, `/api/pwa/slOauth`, `/api/pwa/slVerified`, `/api/pwa/slVerify`, `/api/pwa/updateUserProfile`, `/api/pwa/shortlisthotel`, `/api/pwa/shortlisted-hotels-list`, `/api/pwa/validate-wizard-coupon`, `/api/pwa/validateTravelAgentCode`, `/api/pwa/getSeoContent`, `/api/pwa/policy-check`, `/api/pwa/referral/deeplink`, `/api/pwa/yoImageUpload`, `/api/pwa/verifyDonation`.
- Client code further labels identifiers/parameters including `phone_number`, `email`, `bookingId`, `bookingToken`, `token`, `country`, `retUrl`, `hotel-id`, and uses social login options Google/Facebook/Apple/Truecaller.
- Page references PWA manifest `/manifest-checkin.json`, Android deep link `android-app://com.oyo.consumer/https/www.oyorooms.com/`, and static chunks under `/assets/desktop/`.

## Redirect and availability map
- `http://www.oyorooms.com/` 200 but empty 108-byte HTML response (journal `b12c8a06-fced-433d-8abd-ac8bc38d1dfa`).
- `http://www.oyorooms.io/` proxy/upstream failure (502; journal `ac48a509-3c9f-40fb-b371-d9bf2bc89f38`).
- `http://www.oyoos.com/` → `https://www.oyoos.com/` (301); destination not followed because the approved target specifies HTTP only.
- `https://patron.oyorooms.com/` → `/kr/` (302), then `/kr/` → `/kr/kr/` (302), a locale-prefix redirect loop. No forms/pages reached.
- `http://www.weddingz.in/` → `http://weddingz.in/` (302); canonical apex returned 403 (no public page content). 
- HTTP roots redirect to HTTPS (not followed, per approved scheme): `www.oyocircle.com`, `www.workflobyoyo.com`, `www.oyoworkspaces.com`, `www.oyotownhouse.com`, `www.innov8.work` (all 301).

## Technologies
- Checkin: React Helmet, Webpack chunked JS, PWA manifest, likely shared OYO consumer client. Response headers include HSTS and explicit CSP `frame-ancestors` allowlist. External static assets reference `assets.oyoroomscdn.com` / `images.oyoroomscdn.com`.
- Redirecting OYO legacy properties were served via Akamai/GitHub/CDN indicators where headers exposed them; no application markup was accessed.

Raw downloaded evidence is retained in `/tmp/oyo_surface` during this run.

92051a.title: Prism Life and mobile-store listing surface map
92051a.content:
Passive discovery scoped to `https://prismlife.com/` and the supplied Apple/Google listing URLs.

## Approved host and deployment
- Host observed: `prismlife.com` over HTTPS; homepage and all discovered public HTML routes returned `200`.
- Response evidence: `Server: AmazonS3`, `Via`/`X-Cache`/`X-Amz-Cf-*` CloudFront headers. Captured browser exchange `20435985-0115-4ab2-9bd4-d5ae565fdae0` confirms same-origin static CSS delivery (`200`, S3/CloudFront).
- No redirect was observed on homepage or the discovered HTML routes. `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, and `site.webmanifest` are declared/checked but return S3 `NoSuchKey` 404.

## Public HTML routes (all GET)
- `/` and `/index.html` — primary single-page corporate site with client-side anchors `#home`, `#brands`, `#culture`, `#investors`, `#newsroom`, `#contact`.
- `/investor-relations.html` — investor overview/board and contacts.
- `/governance.html` — anchors `#annual-reports`, `#annual-returns`, `#policies`, `#general-meetings`.
- `/ipo-kit.html` — anchors `#udrhp-section`, `#supporting-section`; document accordions and YouTube video modal.
- `/annual-reports.html`, `/annual-returns.html`, `/general-meetings.html` — archival investor document indexes.
- `Annual_Report_FY26.pdf` was directly linked from homepage and returned `200`; investor pages enumerate public annual reports FY22–FY26, annual returns FY21–FY25, governance-policy PDFs, shareholder-meeting PDFs under `Shareholders%20Meeting/`, UDRHP/industry-report PDFs, and financial PDFs under `Material%20Subsidiaries/`.

## Forms, parameters, and client routes
- No `<form>`, `<input>`, `<select>`, or `<textarea>` elements in the seven public HTML pages above; no GET query parameters or POST/action routes observed.
- Interactivity is client-side only: nav anchors, carousel/filter buttons, document accordions, and a YouTube modal. No first-party XHR/fetch/API route was found in first-party JS.
- `/js/globe.js` fetches the external `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2/countries-50m.json` for visualization; not accessed because outside approved scope.

## Static/client technology
- First-party: `/css/normalize.css`, `/css/slick.css`, `/scss/main.css`, `/js/vendor/modernizr-3.6.0.min.js`, `/js/vendor/jquery-3.6.0.min.js`, `/js/plugins.js`, `/js/main.js`, `/js/globe.js`; also first-party OTF font and image assets.
- Declared external client dependencies: jQuery `3.6.0`, Modernizr `3.6.0`, Slick, GSAP, Three.js `0.160.0`, TopoJSON Client `3`, Globe.gl `2.45.2`, Google Fonts (Host Grotesk/Inter), plus out-of-scope CDN visual-data request above.
- Homepage declares out-of-scope video asset `https://assets.oyoroomscdn.com/Prism+-+Launch+AV+(1).mp4` and social/news links; none followed.

## Store listings
- Supplied Apple identifiers (public URL paths): OYO Hotel Booking App & Deals `id988141624`; CO-OYO `id1424149517`; Weddingz.in `id1465687681`; OYO Workspaces `id1448023664`.
- Each exact Apple URL returned `403` from the scope enforcement layer before listing content was delivered; no listing metadata, store links, forms, or query parameters could be observed.
- Supplied Google Play URL is exactly `/store/apps/details` with no `id` query parameter. It likewise returned scope-layer `403`; no application/package identifier is present in supplied scope or observable content.

## Discovery gaps
- Store metadata, screenshots, developer links, and Android package IDs remain unavailable due to proxy scope blocks.
- No sitemap/robots/manifest is published at the standard paths, so unlinked static pages beyond declared links were not enumerated.
